_comment: Portable subset of <project>/.claude/settings.json. SessionStart picks a random session colour from the same 8-colour list the convo picker mirrors; UserPromptSubmit sets the terminal title from a '>>topic' prompt. Merge into the project's hooks block — do not replace the file.

hooks.command: colors=(red blue green yellow purple orange pink cyan); idx=$((RANDOM % 8)); color=${colors[$idx]}; printf '{"systemMessage":"Random color: %s — type /color %s"}' "$color" "$color"

topic=$(jq -r '.prompt // .message // .content // empty' | head -1 | sed -n 's/.*>>[[:space:]]*\([a-zA-Z0-9_-]*\).*/\1/p' | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]'); if [ -n "$topic" ]; then printf '\033]0;%s \033\\' "$topic" > /dev/tty 2>/dev/null || true; printf '{"suppressOutput":true}'; else printf '{"suppressOutput":true}'; fi
